v0.1.0.description:
This is the initial public alpha for the OSFE apworld. Limited testing has been done, so expect bugs and instability.

[Client Mod](https://github.com/Surreptitious1/OSFE-Archipelago-Client-Mod/releases/tag/v0.1.0)

## Items

* Hero loadouts
* Spell reward unlocks
* Artifact reward unlocks
* Hell Pass reductions
* Upgraders, Removers, and Sera
* Misc. stat boosts

## Locations

* Zone progression per hero loadout
* Boss kills and spares

## Goal

* Customizable combination of winning runs
  * Neutral, Pacifist, Genocide, or nonspecific ending

## Additional Features

* Randomized starting loadout (artifacts and spells)
